zh.title: 國泰貨運再獲ATW年度貨運營運商　A350F交付後將進一步擴充運能
zh.summary: 國泰貨運獲ATW 2027年度航空業成就獎「年度貨運營運商」，為自2023年以來第4度獲獎；公司同時持續推進A350F機隊更新與短期貨運運能擴充。
body: 國泰貨運（Cathay Cargo）再度獲得航空業界獎項肯定，於《Air Transport World》（ATW）2027年度航空業成就獎（Airline Industry Achievement Awards）獲選為「年度貨運營運商」（Cargo Operator of the Year）。這是國泰貨運自2023年以來第4度獲得該項榮譽，先前分別於2023、2025及2026年度獲獎。
ATW表示，本屆為第52屆航空業成就獎，評選涵蓋航空公司、機場及航空產業不同領域。國泰貨運此次獲獎主要肯定其持續提升貨運服務、以客戶需求為核心的營運策略，以及近年在數位化、科技與永續發展方面的投資。
這也是國泰貨運近年持續擴張貨運業務之際，再度取得ATW肯定。國泰貨運總監Dominic Perret表示，公司將持續投資機隊、數位能力與航線網路，並進一步強化以香港國際機場（HKG）為核心的貨運轉運能力。國泰集團目前已投入約1,500億港元於機隊、客艙與貴賓室產品及數位創新等項目。
機隊方面，國泰貨運目前營運20架Boeing 747系列全貨機，包括14架747-8F及6架747-400ERF；未來主要機隊更新計畫則聚焦於新一代Airbus A350F。國泰最初於2023年訂購6架A350F，並於2026年5月再將2架採購權轉為確定訂單，使A350F確定訂購數量增加至8架，另外保留18架採購選擇權。
A350F為Airbus以A350平台發展的新一代全貨機，國泰將利用新機逐步擴充並更新現有長程貨運機隊。國泰貨運指出，A350F不僅將增加可用貨運運能，也有助於提升機隊部署彈性及營運效率，並藉由新世代機體與發動機技術降低燃油消耗與排放。
不過，A350F的交付時程近年受到整體研發計畫調整影響。國泰貨運最新公布的進度顯示，Airbus目前已有兩架A350F測試機進入土魯斯最終組裝線，首架測試機機體結構已完成，並裝上大型主貨艙門，後續將進入地面及飛行測試。國泰目前正以2028年迎接A350F加入機隊為準備方向。
除了長期導入A350F外，國泰也採取短期增加運能的方式因應貨運需求。集團已租入一架由A330客機改裝而成的A330P2F貨機，交由旗下香港華民航空（Air Hong Kong）營運，主要投入大陸地區及區域貨運航線，以在A350F正式交付前增加可用貨運能力。
國泰貨運近年的機隊投資顯示，其貨運布局將形成現有747大型全貨機、A330P2F區域運能，以及未來A350F新一代長程貨機並行的架構。隨8架A350F陸續交付，國泰貨運的長程運能、燃油效率及機隊調度彈性預期都將進一步提升。

en.title: Cathay Cargo Wins ATW Cargo Operator of the Year Again as A350F Deliveries Set to Expand Capacity
en.summary: Cathay Cargo has been named ATW's 2027 Cargo Operator of the Year, its fourth win since 2023, as it continues fleet investment and prepares for the introduction of the Airbus A350F.
body: Cathay Cargo has again received major industry recognition, winning Cargo Operator of the Year in Air Transport World's 2027 Airline Industry Achievement Awards. It is the fourth time Cathay Cargo has received the honor since 2023, following previous wins in 2023, 2025 and 2026.

ATW said the latest awards mark the 52nd edition of its Airline Industry Achievement Awards, covering airlines, airports and a range of aviation-sector categories. Cathay Cargo's recognition reflects its continued improvements in cargo services, customer-focused operating strategy, and recent investment in digitalization, technology and sustainability.

The award comes as Cathay Cargo continues to expand its freight business. Cathay Cargo Director Dominic Perret said the company will keep investing in fleet, digital capabilities and network development while strengthening Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) as a cargo hub. The Cathay Group has committed around HK$150 billion to fleet, cabin and lounge products, digital innovation and other investments.

Cathay Cargo currently operates 20 Boeing 747 freighters, including 14 747-8Fs and six 747-400ERFs. Its main long-term fleet renewal program is centered on the next-generation Airbus A350F. Cathay initially ordered six A350Fs in 2023 and in May 2026 converted two purchase rights into firm orders, increasing the confirmed total to eight aircraft while retaining 18 purchase options.

The A350F is Airbus' new-generation freighter developed from the A350 platform. Cathay plans to use the aircraft to expand and progressively modernize its long-haul freighter fleet. The airline says the A350F will add available cargo capacity while improving fleet deployment flexibility and operating efficiency, with newer airframe and engine technology also reducing fuel burn and emissions.

The A350F delivery schedule has, however, been affected by changes to the wider development program. Cathay Cargo's latest update says Airbus now has two A350F test aircraft on the final assembly line in Toulouse. The first test airframe has completed structural assembly and received its large main-deck cargo door, with ground and flight testing to follow. Cathay is currently preparing for the A350F to enter its fleet in 2028.

In addition to the longer-term A350F program, Cathay has also taken short-term steps to add capacity. The group has leased an A330 passenger-to-freighter conversion, an A330P2F, for operation by subsidiary Air Hong Kong. The aircraft is intended mainly for mainland China and regional freight services, providing additional capacity before the A350F enters service.

Cathay Cargo's recent fleet investment points toward a future structure combining its existing 747 large freighters, A330P2F regional capacity and the A350F as a new-generation long-haul freighter. As the eight A350Fs are delivered, Cathay Cargo is expected to gain additional long-haul capacity, improved fuel efficiency and greater fleet scheduling flexibility.
